d: Are you a dynamic and results-driven hospitality professional with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences? Look no further! Join us as the Director of Rooms and lead our talented team in creating a welcoming and comfortable environment for our valued guests. Bring your high energy, enthusiasm, and commitment to excellence, and be a driving force in shaping memorable stays and exceeding guest expectations. If you thrive in a fast-paced, guest-centric environment and have a proven track record in rooms management, we want you on our team!

The Director of Rooms is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the Rooms Division, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, and maintaining high service and operational standards. This role includes managing the Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Services, Concierge, Laundry, Recreation/Spa , driving revenue opportunities, and fostering a culture of excellence in hospitality.
q: Champion the Park Hyatt brand ethos of understated luxury and personalized service.
Oversee all aspects of the guest journey from pre-arrival to departure, ensuring seamless coordination between hotel and resort services.
Lead service recovery for VIPs and high-profile guests, ensuring issues are resolved promptly and elegantly.
Monitor guest satisfaction metrics (e.g., Medallia, LQA, Forbes) and continuously elevate service standards.
Manage daily operations of Front Office, Housekeeping, Concierge, Spa/Wellness, Laundry, and support integration with Golf & Yacht Club guest services.
Optimize workflows and SOPs to deliver consistency and operational efficiency.
Lead departmental heads in maintaining brand standards across all guest-facing areas.
Ensure adherence to all internal Hyatt policies, brand standards, SOPs, and audit requirements related to guest services, operations, and colleague conduct.
Develop and manage the Rooms Division’s annual budget and forecasts.
Control labor costs, operating expenses, and capital improvements aligned with business strategy.
Maximize revenue through room inventory management, upselling, and ancillary services.
Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing Rooms team.
Ensure all colleagues are trained in Forbes/Park Hyatt service standards and operational procedures.
Drive Hyatt’s "Care for People" culture by supporting colleague well-being, recognition, and career development.
Contribute to the hotel’s Executive Committee with strategic input on guest experience, service innovation, and operational planning.
Collaborate with Sales, Events, F&B, Engineering, and Golf operations to ensure a unified guest experience across the estate.
Lead initiatives tied to Hyatt’s Ways of Working (WoW), DEI, and sustainability goals.
Ensure full compliance with Dubai Municipality and UAE regulatory standards related to hygiene, health, and safety.
Oversee emergency and crisis management procedures within the Rooms Division.
Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management or equivalent. Master’s or executive education is a plus.
Minimum 5 years of progressive rooms leadership experience in luxury hospitality, preferably in resort or mixed-use environments.
Prior experience in leading large-scale operations with integrated wellness, leisure, and lifestyle components.
Expertise in Opera PMS, HotSOS, and other Hyatt systems is preferred.
Strong financial acumen with proven budget and cost control experience.
High emotional intelligence, cultural sensitivity, and guest-centric mindset.
Fluent in English; knowledge of other EU languages.

d: Collect keys and daily assignments before preparing trolley and sufficient equipment in order to perform designated tasks and duties efficiently and to avoid delays effectively
Maintain and clean Guest rooms and replenish room supplies as per the Standards of Performance of the Hotel
Maintain and clean bathrooms and replenish bathroom amenities according to the Standards of Performance and the safety standards of the Hotel
Tidy and arrange Guest belongings when cleaning Guest rooms and bathrooms in order to ensure compliance to the Leading Quality Assurance standards of the Hotel
Inform Valet Service to collect Guest clothes for laundry, dry cleaning or pressing in order to maintain Guest satisfaction
Maintain and clean Guest corridors, service pantries and service areas in order to ensure a professional and organised appearance
Report any maintenance related issues to the Engineering Department to ensure general upkeep and maintenance of facilities
Consider Guest needs and requirements when working in public areas and Guest rooms to ensure courtesy and Guest satisfaction
Operate in a safe and environmentally friendly way to protect guests’ and employees’ health and safety, as well as protect and conserve the environment
Comply with the hotel environmental, health and safety policies and procedures
q: High School education or equivalent experiences.
Preferred experience in a luxury hotel in Housekeeping.
Have a high level of attention to detail.
Knowledge and the ability to operate cleaning equipment.
Ability to understand and working knowledge of English.
Must be flexible with schedule - Able to work weekdays, weekends, holidays, evening/overnight shifts

d: We are seeking a proactive and collaborative Scrum Master to support Agile teams in delivering high-quality products and solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience with Scrum methodologies, strong facilitation skills, and the ability to foster continuous improvement within cross-functional teams.
q: 3–5 years of experience in Scrum Master, Agile delivery, or related roles.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum and Kanban.
Proven experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and supporting Agile teams.
Familiarity with Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Trello.
Strong communication, facilitation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
Experience working with cross-functional software development teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and support team collaboration in a remote environment.
Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

li
Coach development teams on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement.
li
Identify and help remove impediments affecting team productivity and delivery.
li
Collaborate with Product Owners to ensure effective backlog management and sprint planning.
li
Monitor team performance using Agile metrics such as velocity, burndown charts, and sprint progress.
li
Promote effective communication and collaboration between development teams and stakeholders.
li
Support teams in maintaining transparency, accountability, and continuous delivery.
li

li

d: Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Contracts Manager to join our team for a major port project in Kuwait. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in overseeing all aspects of contract management for this significant infrastructure development.
Develop, negotiate, and manage complex contracts related to the port project, ensuring compliance with local and international regulations
Oversee the entire contract lifecycle, from initiation to closeout, for multiple stakeholders and subcontractors
Implement and maintain effective contract management systems and processes
Identify and mitigate contractual risks, resolving disputes and claims in a timely manner
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, procurement, and construction, to ensure project objectives are met
Prepare and analyze financial reports, forecasts, and budgets related to contract performance
Provide regular status updates and reports to senior management and stakeholders
Stay current with local construction codes, maritime regulations, and international best practices in contract management
q: Minimum 15 years of experience in contract management for large-scale construction projects
Extensive knowledge of international contract law and FIDIC contracts
Proven track record in successfully managing complex contracts and resolving contractual disputes
Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
Strong leadership skills with the ability to work in a multicultural environment
Willingness to relocate to Kuwait for the duration of the project

d: We are currently looking for dynamic, passionate, and self-motivated Food & Beverage professionals who are eager to grow their careers in hospitality.

As a Waiter / Waitress, you will play an important role in creating memorable dining experiences for our guests. You will provide warm, professional, and personalized service while ensuring that every guest feels welcomed, valued, and well cared for throughout their visit.

You should ideally have a diploma in Hospitality Management or relevant vocational training in Food & Beverage, with previous experience as a Waiter / Waitress, preferably in a high-volume restaurant, hotel, or similar hospitality environment.

A good command of English is essential, along with strong guest service, communication, and interpersonal skills. You should be confident in interacting with guests from diverse backgrounds and committed to delivering a consistently high standard of service.
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on, energetic, and service-oriented professional with a genuine passion for hospitality and creating memorable dining experiences.

You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, remain calm and professional under pressure, and demonstrate strong attention to detail. A positive attitude, pleasant personality, and willingness to support the team are essential for success in this role.
You should possess the following key competencies
